conversation_parts.body: Hi Bryn, I’m Quenna from Penhallow Specialty Risks — we’re having trouble pulling the latest reserves report for a high-value marine claim, and it’s holding up our payment cycle.
Thanks for reaching out, Quenna. I’ll check the integrations on your account to see if there’s a sync delay affecting the reserves data. Could you confirm the policyholder ID or claim reference?
The claim reference is A17-MAR-0089. We’ve already reprocessed the documents twice but the reserves still aren’t updating in the reporting tab.

Got it. I’ll run a manual refresh on that claim’s reserves and check for any supplier-side delays. You should see the updated figures within 15 minutes — I’ll follow up with an email if anything’s blocking it.
Appreciate the quick response. We’re under pressure to close this before the end of the quarter, so timely updates really help.
Understood — I’ll keep you posted. If you need to assign additional tasks or adjust roles for this claim, let me know and I’ll walk you through the permissions.
